newsitem.title: CANADA: Bro-X, Bresea win work contracts.
newsitem.headline: Bro-X, Bresea win work contracts.

text.p: Bresea Resources Ltd and Bro-X Minerals Ltd said on Monday that they have signed contracts of work for two mining projects in Indonesia.
Bresea and Bro-X are members of the Bre-X Minerals Ltd group of companies. Bre-X is currently embroiled in a controversy over its Busang gold discovery in Indonesia.

The contracts of work signed with the Indonesian government on Monday are for the Sangihe Project and Sable Project. Bro-X has a 60-percent stake in Sangihe, Bresea has 30 percent and the remaining 10 percent is held by an Indonesian partner.
The Sable Project is 80-percent owned by Bro-X and 20-percent owned by an Indonesian partner.
Since the Busang controversy broke last month, the Indonesian government has put on hold two applications by Bre-X for contracts of work for the site.
Investors dumped Bre-X shares last month after Busang partner Freeport-McMoRan Copper & Gold Inc said its preliminary tests had found "insignificant" amounts of gold.
Bre-X is expected to receive an independent audit of its Busang project by end of this week.
Within the Bre-X Minerals group of companies, Bresea owns 22.3 percent of Bre-X. Bresea also owns 22.7 percent of Bro-X.
